hashes.coverage: Ten files: eight relevant production modules, unchanged original recovery helper, new isolated diagnostic. Root owns the separate complete frozen source/test/build manifest.

fixture_preconditions.actual_entry: Unchanged helpers.run_cli -> actual prepare_supervised outer controller -> fresh python -m docs.evidence.snapshots.c3_terminal_restart_diagnostic -> unchanged helpers._child_main -> cli.main/Orze/native/F
fixture_preconditions.hardware_boundary: Existing helper's GPU/provider/legacy-repair entry points are explicit forbidden-call spies; no actual GPU/provider operations.
fixture_preconditions.configuration: Private same-Lake CPU project, slots=1, wall_budget_seconds=6, each action timeout=2; expired case explicitly shortens its runtime lease to 1 second. No production config is loaded.
fixture_preconditions.expired_worker: Original helper worker audit and answer.json write retained. Its final exit is replaced only in the diagnostic's temporary helper.WORKER value with a real sleeping CPU worker whose SIGTERM handler exits 0. Actual expiry must remain interrupted and publish no successful artifacts or observations.
fixture_preconditions.crash_hook_labels: Both hooks emit the unchanged helper's expected metadata event name crash_before_settle. Each adds an exact boundary field: the confirm case really crashes inside a transparent confirm_effect wrapper after real confirm returned, before the coordinator sees that return; it does not crash at budget.settle.

static_premise_adjustment.detail: Read-only source inspection showed permit.reserved_nanoseconds is a decimal string, not an integer. Diagnostic assertion changed from integer 2000000000 to exact string '2000000000' before its first execution.

fixture_preconditions.cleanup: The unchanged outer owned-supervisor helper obtains real TREE_CLOSED/ECHILD_WALL for each controller; each native action also has real TREE_CLOSED. No host-wide PID census, bare PID signal, guard removal, age takeover, or cleanup of user resources. Only isolated mkdtemp project artifacts remain.

cases.boundary: budget.settle entry after actual expired TERMINAL plus confirmed effect and confirmed effect-guard release
cases.pre_crash_assertions: Actual current full Ref/terminal, BOUND reservation, real committed effect, absent effect guard, v2 expired TREE_CLOSED/ECHILD_WALL, interrupted even return_code=0, zero published artifact/observation IDs
cases.recovery: First fresh CLI records COMPLETE with examined=1 and exactly the captured reservation in settled; second fresh CLI preserves that exact recovery row and reservation.
cases.no_refund: Original exact permit remains charged '2000000000' nanoseconds at all three snapshots.
cases.no_go: Only one native attempt and worker birth, with attempts/artifacts/observations/lifecycle/effect files/audit unchanged across both restarts.

cases.boundary: Transparent actual confirm_effect completes its committed receipt, then diagnostic os._exit(86) while original effect guard is still held and before execution_authority coordinator post-confirm checks
cases.pre_crash_assertions: Actual TERMINAL completed/authorized, real committed digest, real v2 nonexpired TREE_CLOSED, BOUND reservation, original effect guard present. Actual BOOTTIME sampled before bound deadline.
cases.recovery: Fresh F cannot acquire the retained original effect guard. Original guard bytes/nonce remain exact, recovery becomes IN_PROGRESS, and second fresh CLI preserves that same IN_PROGRESS row. No auto-release or takeover was attempted.
cases.after_deadline: The executed diagnostic calculates remaining time with actual CLOCK_BOOTTIME and waits until the old deadline plus 20 ms before first fresh restart. This is a real bounded elapsed-time check, not a claim that age grants authority.
cases.truthful_partial_state: The original SQL completed/authorized terminal, committed effect, and one already-published artifact remain. They are not rewritten to interrupted or falsely reported absent. No post-confirm acceptance or budget SETTLED is fabricated.
cases.no_refund: The same BOUND permit and '2000000000' nanosecond charge remain exact.
cases.no_go: Only one original native attempt/worker birth; both fresh CLI processes return HOLD without new attempts, workers, artifacts, observations, or lifecycle changes.

archive_audit.scope: Read-only recheck of complete archived raw reports, native/controller closure bindings, durable state sequence, unchanged effect/artifact/lifecycle rows, exact charge, zero reexecution, and original raw SHA.

limitations: These are two bounded actual private CPU command-action restart windows, not general fault-tolerance or distributed adoption proof.

The confirm window intentionally preserves a genuinely committed terminal/artifact plus unknown coordinator completion. HOLD and retained guards are the correct outcome; this evidence does not authorize clearing them.
No Domain analysis/observation worker is added here; observation count is zero in both fixtures. Existing separate Domain/F evidence is not relabeled as this run.
No worker, terminal, receipt, or SQLite state is forged. Only narrow crash hooks and the declared diagnostic worker body differ from the original helper.

Exactly-once settlement here means one captured reservation appears in the durable COMPLETE summary and remains byte-identical on the second fresh restart; it is not a claim about arbitrary distributed retries.
No full test suite was run by this diagnostic. Its own pre/post check covers the named ten files, not a fabricated whole-repository audit.
No runtime lease renewal, restart replay of old work, budget refund, or unknown-effect recovery is authorized.
